acceptanceCriteria: A --shared clone fixture gets either a supported result or a refusal naming the alternates cause.
body: Observed in the PR #1073 lane (2026-10-17): in a `git clone --shared` checkout Tasks reports state=unsupported with no reason. Expected: a named reason (alternates object store) or support.
title: Tasks reports misleading state=unsupported in a `git clone --shared` checkout
